title: 儿童 BMI 与脚胖瘦度
source: Personal dashboard sample embedded in js/index.js (area line + ring pies)

units.plumpness: foot length / foot width * 10-style index used on the chart (higher = slimmer/longer relative to width)

notes: The dashboard y-axis is labeled 脚长/脚宽. Values around the mid-20s are typical on this sample.
Ring charts use a highlighted slice vs a remainder placeholder, matching the original option objects.
